column1: # the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory: main sets a heap of the pool less this (2.99 GB, see README.md)
# the game reads texture files into one 1.4 GB pool and makes textures over the data (tex_init_upload), writes some by CPU after nvnTextureInitialize (tex_flush_upload, tex_dirty_upload) and
# fills the others by CopyBufferToTexture; its memory manager moves textures about in the pool with CopyBufferToBuffer, which loses what only the GPU copy put in (tex_copy_mirror)
